focus_areas: Verification of absent functional components (shoulder straps/attachment points).
Structural connectivity of shoulder guards to the main plate.
Authenticity of metallic reflections and distinction of blur artifacts.
Geometric plausibility of the torso curvature.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the shoulder guards meet the chest plate. AI generators often fail to create a clean mechanical connection here, resulting in 'melting' or ambiguous boundaries. Also, verify that the embossed patterns have consistent depth and do not warp unnaturally across the curved surface. Crucially, use the open_vocabulary_detector results to definitively rule out the presence of hidden or low-contrast straps before marking that checkpoint as failed.
image_description: A close-up view of a golden-colored metal breastplate (cuirass) featuring a central vertical ridge, embossed decorative patterns on the lower abdomen section, and rounded shoulder guards. The object has a highly reflective, polished surface with visible light specular highlights.
